title.en: Bob requests a payment, Alice pays

starter.cli:
# c-lightning counts in millisatoshis: 20,000 sats = 20000000 msat.
# Every invoice needs a unique label.
lightning-cli invoice 20000000 chai-1 "Chai ya Bob"
# Then switch the node to Alice and run:  lncli payinvoice --force <bolt11>

solution.cli:
INV=$(lightning-cli invoice 20000000 "chai-$RANDOM$RANDOM" "Chai ya Bob" | jq -r .bolt11)
JIFUNZE_NODE=alice lncli payinvoice --force "$INV"
